'''2000 Origins Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship on Decipher's 2000 summer convention circuit. The winner received a bye to the semifinal round of the World Championship and travel to DecipherCon 2000.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sc00or">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/origins.html Decipher's @ Origins 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231232/http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/origins.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Joe Alread]] of Normal, Illinois won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open championship
* '''Date:''' 13–16 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
